reading.body:
The operator of Alliance Technology in Mesa is not identified in published sources. The facility's location at 4850 East Baseline Road appears in mapping data but yields no website or operator information despite exhausted search; this registry cannot confirm the business entity behind the name.

No published specifications for power capacity, floor space, cooling, or IT load are on file for Alliance Technology. Without these figures, the campus cannot be assessed against the thesis that grid capacity constrains AI scaling, and no reading of its AI relevance is possible.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities and 4 with published power capacity totaling 512 MW. Alliance Technology ranks fifth by published capacity among Arizona facilities, but this ranking reflects only the four facilities with disclosed figures; the majority of Arizona's mapped capacity remains unpublished.
